outcome: Wound healing score (assessed using the Reeda scale)
cohort: 80 women who underwent C-section and were considered susceptible to C-section wound infection at Ommolbanin Hospital, Mashhad, in 2019
finding: While Recove ointment showed some effectiveness in wound healing 5 days after cesarean section, it was not significantly different from the placebo group at 3 and 10 days, suggesting further research is needed.
